title: Pickleball Flame
style: Pop rock with a driving, commercial production style. The arrangement features a bright acoustic guitar strumming sixteenth-note patterns, a clean electric guitar playing melodic lead lines with light chorus and delay, and a punchy bass guitar that follows the kick drum. The drum kit uses a tight snare and a prominent kick drum. A baritone male vocal delivers the lyrics with a gritty, energetic tone, supported by layered vocal harmonies in the chorus. The track is in the key of E major at 124 BPM. Synthesizer pads provide a subtle harmonic wash in the background during the chorus sections. The bridge features a breakdown with filtered drums and a whispered vocal delivery before building back into the final chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[strummed acoustic guitar, clean electric guitar lead riff]
(Mmm-hmm)
[drums and bass enter]
Hey!

[Verse 1]
Game begins right on cue
Different mindset, different view
Pickleball flying, running through my veins
Become centered, focused and true
Your paddle becomes an extension of you

[Chorus]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, vocal harmonies]
Feel it drop, feel it pop
Giving it everything you got
We are here for success
Always playing at your best
Make the most of your tools
They are all that you got
(Mmm-hmm)

[Verse 2]
[acoustic guitar and bass continue, electric guitar accents]
Hands, feel it on the paddle
Eyes allow you to anticipate
Now I'm not late, I'm right on time
Using my senses, make this game mine

[Chorus]
[full band energy]
I want you over, you know it's true
Lives within my heart, could never be blue
Trusting you, only you can make your dreams come true
You, me, us, we, pickleball forever
[drums drop to a filtered beat, whispered vocals]
Can you feel its power?
(Mmm-hmm)

[Outro]
[final drum hit, acoustic guitar ring out]
